comparison_assessments.accuracy_note: Preserves the progression from distress and seeking the Lord to the outstretched hand at night, its persistence, and the speaker's refusal of comfort. The singular hand and first-person perspective remain intact.
comparison_assessments.creative_liberties_note: 'Pain' emphasizes experienced suffering rather than distressing circumstances. 'All night,' 'stayed,' and 'never' make sustained duration explicit. 'Refused all comfort' recasts refusal to be comforted and adds an explicit totalizing 'all.'
comparison_assessments.hebrew_text: בְּי֥וֹם צָרָתִי֮ אֲדֹנָ֢י דָּ֫רָ֥שְׁתִּי יָדִ֤י׀ לַ֣יְלָה נִ֭גְּרָה וְלֹ֣א תָפ֑וּג מֵאֲנָ֖ה הִנָּחֵ֣ם נַפְשִֽׁי׃
literal_backbone: In the day of my distress I sought the Lord.
My hand was stretched out at night and did not slacken.
My soul refused to be comforted.

word_notes.note: Conveys suffering but shifts emphasis from distress or adversity to the speaker's experience of it; physical pain is not specified.

word_notes.lexical_gloss: My hand; night; flow or be poured out, here extend; not grow numb, slacken, or cease.
word_notes.note: 'Stretched out' is a contextual interpretation of the flowing or pouring verb applied to the hand. 'All night' and 'never' draw sustained duration from the night setting and the negated slackening.
word_notes.rendered_as: All night my hand stayed stretched out; it never slackened

word_notes.lexical_gloss: Refuse; be comforted; my self, life, soul.
word_notes.note: Preserves refusal rather than merely an inability to find comfort. 'All' adds emphasis; 'soul' here represents the speaker's self without requiring a separate immaterial entity.

comparison_assessments.accuracy_note: Preserves distress, seeking the Lord, the singular hand extended at night without slackening, and the soul's refusal of comfort, in source order. The bodily image and the distinction between refusing comfort and merely lacking it remain intact.
comparison_assessments.creative_liberties_note: 'Reached' makes the extended hand an active gesture. 'All night' strengthens the duration from 'by night,' supported contextually by the lack of slackening. 'Would not' gives that persistence a slightly more determined tone.
comparison_assessments.hebrew_text: בְּי֥וֹם צָרָתִי֮ אֲדֹנָ֢י דָּ֫רָ֥שְׁתִּי יָדִ֤י׀ לַ֣יְלָה נִ֭גְּרָה וְלֹ֣א תָפ֑וּג מֵאֲנָ֖ה הִנָּחֵ֣ם נַפְשִֽׁי׃
literal_backbone: In the day of my distress I sought the Lord;
my hand was stretched out by night and did not slacken;
my soul refused to be comforted.

word_notes.lexical_gloss: My hand; night; flow, pour out, extend or stretch out.
word_notes.note: Adopts the contextual extended-hand sense of נגר. 'Reached' presents the posture dynamically; 'all' is inferred from the continuing gesture rather than separately expressed.

word_notes.lexical_gloss: And not; grow numb, become feeble, slacken, cease.
word_notes.note: Preserves the hand's unabated extension. 'Fall' supplies a physical detail, while 'would not' can suggest determination beyond the Hebrew's negated action.

renderings.differentiator: Keeps the bodily image alongside the soul's refusal.
